access.package: any of ORCA, Psi4, PySCF, NWChem
access.notes: Free for academic use. Must support BP86, B3PW91* (custom functional), CCSD(T), basis set input and orbital reuse.
Standard basis set (Fe: 17s9p6d/6s3p3d; C,O: 11s6p/5s3p) available in Basis Set Exchange or built into quantum chemistry packages.
Fe: (17s12p8d3f2g1h)/[6s5p6d3f2g1h]; C,O: cc-pVDZ. Detailed description in paper; can be constructed from standard Dunning and Ricca–Bauschlicher basis sets.
B3PW91 hybrid with 15% exact exchange (c3=0.15). Parameters can be set in most QC packages via custom functional or input keywords.
